name: file-toolbar
title: File Toolbar
description: Work on a file: its name (rename in place), save state, the actions you use most, overflow into More by priority as space shrinks, and one primary action. Roving keyboard focus.

meta.intent: Work on a file: see and change its name and state, and reach its actions at any width.

docs: Wrap your app in TooltipProvider. Shortcuts are display-only; bind them in your app.
